**Finding: Compliant** — no redline required.

Section 28 already matches our preferred position:
- **§ 28.1** — governed by the laws of the State of New York (with CISG expressly excluded).
- **§ 28.2** — exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, with irrevocable submission to personal jurisdiction.

No arbitration provision exists anywhere in the agreement, and there is no competing governing-law or forum language in any other section, so the walk-away risk (UK home-jurisdiction venue or a foreign-seated arbitration) does not arise notwithstanding that Brightline is a UK entity. The mutual carve-out for temporary injunctive relief and the pre-filing executive escalation (which expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings) are both customary and acceptable.
